'''The Oasis''' &ndash; or simply '''"Oasis"''' &ndash; was a [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] religious community in the middle of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], far from any larger [[City/Legends|cities]].

==History==
The Oasis consisted of several distinctly [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] houses and a number of [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]].

The people of Oasis were friendly and trusting, welcoming travelers of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. The inhabitants did not ask question of their visitors, but entertained them with [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], drink, and song. They respected the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] because of their communal relationship with the [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]], which the Dim-U held to be sacred. Banthas roamed the streets, and children often played on them.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Jodo Kast]] and a crew of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] came to Oasis looking for information on [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]]. When Kast grew angry at the lack of information, the high priest of Oasis, [[Dryon]], expelled him and his group from the [[City/Legends|town]], as anger was not the way of the bantha. Kast's partner [[Zardra]] later returned to attack the village and get information, but she was repelled by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] who had come to the town in the meantime.
